Rock ! ... | 40-40This would guarantee an ore every swing. |} ===Stamina=== [[File:Full stamina.gif|thumb|A player with full stamina|250px]] At Mining level 15, players unlock the ''stamina'' multiplier mechanic of the damage formula. Every swing drains 10 stamina, but stamina is refilled completely upon clicking a rock. Damage done to a rock reduces as stamina depletes, see table below. Stamina is indicated by a bar under the mining progress bar and alternatively by green and white sparks representing full and partial stamina, respectively. While enabled by default, the stamina bar can be hidden. {| class="wikitable align-center-1 align-center-2 align-center-3 align-center-4" ! Stamina ! Damage (%) |- | 100 | 100 |- | 1-99 | 90 |- | 0 | 20 |} [[File:1 - 99 percent stamina.mp4|thumb|A player with partial (1% - 99%) stamina|250px]] Players begin with 30 stamina which increases by 10 at certain Mining level milestones listed in the following table. Additionally, 1 stamina is added for every [[Agility]] level, providing an additional swing for every 10 Agility levels rounded up. (i.e., level 1-10 Agility would provide 1 extra swing, level 31-40 Agility would provide 4 extra swings). Therefore, the minimum stamina is 31 (30 from Mining and 1 from Agility), giving a minimum of 4 swings before running out. [[Temporary skill boost]]s which cause a visible increase in the player's Agility level do affect the calculation of stamina. At 88+ Mining and 91+ Agility, a player's stamina will last for 21 swings (50.4 seconds). As stamina improves, so does the damage per hour for semi-active players. The mechanic supports both active and semi-active gameplay. Active mining requires the player to maintain full stamina by clicking the rock once every 4 ticks (2.4 s). Semi-active mining assumes many forms, such as only clicking ''rockertunities'' while mining core rocks, or only refilling the stamina bar when it empties completely. {| class="wikitable align-center-1 align-center-2 align-center-3 align-center-4" !
